name: batch_move
description:
Move multiple Outlook messages to a folder at once. More efficient than moving one at a time.

Use outlook_list_folders to find folder IDs, or use well-known names (inbox, archive, deleteditems, etc.).

message_ids.description: List of message IDs to move (from outlook_search results)

destination_folder_id.description: Destination folder ID (from outlook_list_folders) or well-known name: inbox, drafts, sentitems, deleteditems, archive, junkemail
